specs.title: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: Precondition: create a new customer, nobody is logged in
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Click `Add to Basket` on the product
3. Open the basket with the button `Your Basket`
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: 1. Open the basket and click `Checkout`
2. Select the saved address and click `Continue`
3. Select `One Day Delivery` and click `Continue`
4. Redeem the 10% coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and click `Continue`
1. Open the basket, check out and continue with the saved address
2. Select `Standard Delivery` and click `Continue`
3. Read the wallet pay button
4. Open `Order History` from the account menu
5. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Check out again with the saved address and `Standard Delivery`
7. Click the wallet pay button
8. Click `Place your order and pay`
9. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
10. Open `Order History` from the account menu
